lead_path_alignment.classification: invalid_facet_citation_count=0; off_path_citation_count=6; all off-path citations are cascade flagged steps on resampled alternatives, not facet evidence; CheatBench has no cloud projection rows and is reported unavailable

lead_path_alignment.unavailable_boundary: a lead with no on-path cited step yields no projected anchor; its re-check judgment is unknown, never a negative
